summary: Frontend-only verification of Priser page fixes: (1) Grunnlegger tier removal, (2) 2-column grid layout, (3) Norwegian typo fix. All 3 bug fixes VERIFIED PASSING on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No regressions on Landing 6-box grid.
verified_fixes: PASS: No 'Grunnlegger' tier card on /priser (text count 0, GRUNNLEGGER badge count 0) on both desktop and mobile
PASS: Exactly 2 tier cards render — BETA (gratis, 3 mnd) + ORDINÆR (149 kr/mnd)
PASS: Typo fixed — 'Alt lagret kun på din konto' present, old 'Alt scoped kun til din konto' absent
PASS: Desktop grid uses md:grid-cols-2 (bounding box width 900px, cards side-by-side visually)
PASS: Mobile stacks to 1 column (grid-cols-1 base class) — verified at 390px viewport
PASS: Cycle toggle works — Månedlig shows 149, Årlig shows 1290, toggling back restores 149
PASS: 'Velg ordinær' CTA button visible and clickable (Stripe checkout wired to lookup_key=bragr_monthly_nok/bragr_yearly_nok — code path unchanged)
PASS: Landing regression — 6-box grid (01–06) renders correctly, no side effects
critical_code_review_comments: FOUNDER constant (bragr_monthly_founder / bragr_yearly_founder) is still declared at top of /app/frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.jsx lines 16-19 but no longer referenced anywhere in the component after Grunnlegger removal. Safe to delete dead code.
Unused destructured variable `founderEligible = status?.founder_eligible` on line 47 is also now dead code — no reader remains after tier removal. Recommend cleanup.

Console shows two 401 errors from GET /billing/status when anonymous users hit /priser. Expected (auth-gated endpoint, caught silently), but consider gating the call behind `if (user)` more explicitly to avoid noise in DevTools — currently code does check `if (!user) return` so 401 comes only for logged-in-but-token-invalid states; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Priser page now has only 2 tiers (BETA + ORDINÆR). Founder tier and its Stripe lookup_keys (bragr_monthly_founder, bragr_yearly_founder) remain in backend but are no longer surfaced in UI — this is intentional per E1's note. Dead code exists in PricingPage.jsx (FOUNDER const + founderEligible var) — optional cleanup only.
rca of the issue: Fix was applied correctly by E1: (1) Removed the third <Tier> component for Grunnlegger, (2) changed grid class from md:grid-cols-3 to md:grid-cols-2 with max-w-[900px], (3) subtitle text updated from 'scoped kun til din konto' to 'lagret kun på din konto'. All three surface-level requirements met and verified visually + programmatically.
